name: finn-ui-library
description: Theme-first UI library monorepo for Finn UI.

scripts.check:pack: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @finn-ui/tokens pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @finn-ui/theme pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @finn-ui/react pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:packages && pnpm check:pack && pnpm build:playground && pnpm build:storybook
